title: Transport-independent product-run operations
description: The documents ummanu.webproto's operations return. A run's state values are the read layer's own five; the exit status beside them is the process's, not a sixth name for it; and whether a run is over is the separate `ended` fact rather than a value.

record.description: What this product owns about one run and what a later reader needs to find it.

ended.description: Fact one on the record: this run is over. Written by the settle and never derived from the value beside it.

settled_state.description: Fact two: how this run ended, one of the read layer's five values. `source_unavailable` is an ending like any other -- the run is over and what it did could not be established.

phase.description: Where this run is in its lifecycle. `raising` is the write-ahead phase: the record can address and stop a head, and a spawn may have happened. `unresolved` is a close that could not be confirmed -- the run stays unsettled, so the card stays fenced.

settled_exit.description: The exit status this run's ending was read off, recorded with the ending so it outlives the run directory.

settled_result.description: The result document this run's ending was read off, recorded with the ending for the same reason.

value.description: How this run ended, or what its process is doing. One of the read layer's five, and never a statement about whether the run is over -- that is `ended`.

ended.description: Whether this run is over: the process it may have held is provably gone -- a confirmed stop, or a launch identity that says there is nothing there -- or none was ever spawned. The only fact that frees a card for the next run, and deliberately not derived from `value`: a head that is gone while its journal cannot be read is over under `source_unavailable`, and a run whose launch identity itself cannot be read is not.

exit.description: The head process's own exit status. A normal ending is code 0; a non-zero exit and a process killed by a signal are told apart here rather than by a sixth state.

reads.description: How this run is read back through the read layer that already exists. There is no run history and no run outcome store to point at.

runs.description: Every product run of one card (`run_list`), each item the whole `product_run` document `run_state` returns. No runs is an empty list.
